title: rt: suggest `.await` in nested `block_on` panic
body:
## Motivation

Calling `Runtime::block_on` or `Handle::block_on` from an async context panics. The existing message explains that the runtime cannot block its executor thread, but it does not tell the caller how to resolve the problem.

## Solution

Append a short hint that recommends awaiting the future directly when the caller is already in an async function.

Extend the existing nesting test to assert the complete panic message, including the new hint, across the current-thread and multi-thread scheduler variants.

## Testing

N/A

Closes #3960
